title: Pilot study on the use of guided imagery interventions prior to and during chemotherapy and immunotherapy in cancer patients and their effects on symptom burden
summary: Viele Krebspatient*innen erleben während einer Chemo- oder Immuntherapie gleichzeitig körperliche und psychische Beschwerden, die ihre Lebensqualität beeinträchtigen. Die Studie untersucht, ob Imaginationsverfahren – das gedankliche Aufsuchen eines generischen Wohlfühlortes – diese Belastungen reduzieren können. Dafür erhalten die Proband*innen Audiodateien, die sie über sechs Wochen regelmäßig anhören. Vor und nach der Übung werden Symptome in kurzen Fragebögen bzw. einem Symptomtagebuch erfasst.
conditions: Cancer patients receiving immune therapy or chemotherapy

interventions.name: Intervention Group: Oncological patients complete a questionnaire assessing demographic characteristics, symptom burden, psychosocial distress, and health-related quality of life. Participants are provided with audio recordings of two different guided imageries, which they are instructed to use over

Waitlist Control Group: Oncological patients complete a questionnaire assessing demographic data, symptom burden, psychosocial distress, and health-related quality of life. At the end of study participation, symptom burden, psychosocial distress, and health-related quality of life are reassessed.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Oncological patients
- German language comprehension
- Written informed consent provided by the participant after receiving study information
- Access to the internet
- participant owns a mobile device (smartphone/tablet)
Exclusion criteria:
- Concurrent participation in other supportive intervention studies
- Lack of informed consent from the patient
- Insufficient language comprehension
- Hearing impairments
- No access to a mobile device
